answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the prism graph is rebuilt each epoch, the trellis merge is applied at settlement and the zephyr audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 13 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 40 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
